name: Darthacht
text: Darthacht is a variant spelling of the name Durthacht. Durthacht is the father of Eógan mac Durthacht in the Ulster Cycle. The dictionary routes this spelling to that family record. Readers will find the son's full dossier under the Eógan mac Durthacht entry.
